declarations.plan: KALAYANTRA_RELAUNCH_PLAN_v2_2.md §6 (item declaration); written by fleet/kyreconcile.py, never by hand
declarations.applies_to: every executable item (one that is not completed by a decision or a join)

completion_kind.code: a merged pull request: independent verdict at the exact reviewed head, then the squash merge commit
completion_kind.artifact: a registered artifact: path + SHA-256, independently accepted at that digest
completion_kind.operation: an executor operation: request and operation identity, completed receipt, independent readback
completion_kind.packet: a packet-exit review: verdict bound to the reviewed packet and its review digest

declarations.producer: the stream that produces the item's evidence (the item's owner); only that stream claims the item

reviewer_rule.v_exact_head_then_deploy_containment: V verdict at the exact PR head by a slot independent of the author; complete once a successful deployment of main contains the squash merge commit
reviewer_rule.v_exact_head_then_post_deploy_at_merge_c: V verdict at the exact PR head, then a second V verdict (post_deploy) at the squash merge commit with the migration or operation readback
reviewer_rule.v_artifact_digest_reviewer_not_author: V verdict bound to the artifact's SHA-256; the reviewer slot differs from the recorded author identity; a V claim only when the item is V-owned
reviewer_rule.finalizer_independent_review_artifact_di: the finalizer's bounded independent reviewer accepts the receipt's exact digest (plan §12), outside ordinary dispatch
reviewer_rule.v_pre_acceptance_then_receipt_readback_d: independent V pre-acceptance of the request, then V acceptance of the completed receipt's digest after measured readback
reviewer_rule.v_packet_verdict_bound_to_external_revie: V packet verdict with no open blocking finding, bound to the review record's digest

declarations.step_evidence: per required step: the evidence class the step must cite and its named detector. detector null = not yet named: the item's packet names it; a STEP action never records a step whose detector is null or has not passed (CLAUDE.md §N.8)
declarations.earned: for an item already completed, completion_kind is the type recorded in its guarded completion event
declarations.triage: class a = critical path (closure of acceptances i–iii); a_close = the close chain (acceptance iv); b = deferred with a re-entry condition, never counted as closed; c = dispositioned under J0_DISPOSITION; retired / retire_decision = retirement by decision (refusal staged, published only by B-2); done_outside = earned completion outside the closure, preserved
